title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Think about what it means for data to be linearly separable. If you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) that perfectly separates the classes, what does that imply about the model's ability to classify the data?

title: Exploring Logistic Regression
text: Consider how logistic regression works. It tries to find a decision boundary that best separates the classes. If the model achieves 100% accuracy, what does that suggest about the decision boundary and the data?

title: Analyzing Training Accuracy
text: If a logistic regression model achieves 100% training accuracy, what can we infer about the relationship between the decision boundary and the data?
